# Residual_Connection

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-07-30

## Definition
A direct skip connection that adds the input of a layer to its output, originally used to enable training of very deep neural networks. Fundamental to modern Transformer and deep network topologies; its removal or modification could drastically alter signal propagation and resource requirements in TCC/iNEST systems.
